environment.description: Terraform provider running in a Docker container on ECS Fargate with default capabilities. Container runs as root with /proc mounted read-write. Network policy allows egress to any destination. No seccomp profile applied. Debug port 6060 is reachable from the task network.

config.capabilities: default Docker capability set (includes CAP_SYS_PTRACE, CAP_NET_RAW, CAP_SYS_ADMIN)
